title: TTE-Flash: Accelerating Reasoning-based Multimodal Representations via Think-Then-Embed Tokens
abstract: arXiv:2605.16638v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent research has demonstrated that Universal Multimodal Embedding (UME) benefits significantly from Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. In this paradigm, a generative model produces explicit reasoning traces for a multimodal query, with the final representation extracted from an  embedding token attending to both the query and the reasoning. Despite its effectiveness, the computational overhead of generating explicit CoT traces is often prohibitive. In this work, we propose replacing explicit CoT with latent think tokens, which are interpreted as latent variables that can produce explicit CoT traces as observed variables. translated_title: TTE-Flash：通过“思考-然后-嵌入”标记加速基于推理的多模态表示
translated_abstract: 最近的研究表明，通用多模态嵌入（UME）能从思维链（CoT）推理中显著受益。在这种范式下，生成式模型为多模态查询生成显式的推理轨迹，最终表示则从同时关注查询和推理的嵌入标记中提取。尽管这种方法有效，但生成显式CoT轨迹的计算开销往往令人望而却步。在本工作中，我们提出用潜在思考标记替代显式CoT，这些标记被解释为能够生成显式CoT轨迹（作为观测变量）的潜在变量。通过使用CoT生成损失优化思考标记，并使用对比损失优化随后的嵌入标记，我们以恒定的推理成本生成了高性能、具备推理感知能力的表示。我们的研究考察了两个关键的架构设计：1）思考标记和嵌入标记应如何从模型中提取……
tldr: 该论文提出TTE-Flash方法，用潜在思考标记替代显式思维链推理，并通过CoT生成损失与对比损失联合优化，以恒定的推理成本实现高性能的推理感知多模态表示。
en_tdlr: TTE-Flash replaces explicit Chain-of-Thought reasoning with latent think tokens optimized via CoT generation loss and contrastive loss, achieving high-performance reasoning-aware multimodal representations at a constant inference cost.
